description: Grip-force sizing of an electric parallel-jaw gripper (DC motor in current control, gearhead, lead screw with direction-dependent efficiency, wedge hook, two synchronised jaws on guides, compliant pads with friction) holding a part during a fast pick-and-place move. Every reference value comes from design/design.py: the sizing rule F >= S m |a - g| / (2 mu) (plus the tilting moment for the block), the reduced 1-DOF closing model (impact peak and the locked-in grip force) and the slip ODE of the slip-threshold run. The scenarios run the same two models with parameter overrides.

requirement in the lift (a_v = 4 m/s^2): m (g + a_v) / (2 mu)
requirement in the transfer (a_h = 20 m/s^2): m sqrt(g^2 + a_h^2) / (2 mu), the sizing case
(b) friction the ball needs, m sqrt((g + a_v)^2 + a_h^2), at the transfer peak
(b) the friction the two jaw contacts deliver follows the requirement over time (the ball creeps but does not slide)
the safety factor in effect, mu (fnA + fnB) / need, never drops below S = 2
